recommended_title: Fixed-Game SHAP Reliability: Structure, Budgets, and Reference Limits
central_question: For frozen tabular classifiers and a fixed empirical probability-scale Shapley game, how do sampled and structure-aware computations compare in single-call reference agreement and repeated-call consistency under finite coalition caps, and what reliability claims remain unsupported?
central_thesis: On the evaluated German Credit and ACS income conditions, structure-aware forest attribution and probability-scale logistic integration yield perfectly consistent observed repeated-call top-three sets and signs and high reference agreement, but reference uncertainty, restricted game semantics, and unequal computational access prevent interpreting these results as general deployment reliability or equal-time superiority.
narrative_rationale: A bounded computational-reliability study is supported by final per-instance attribution arrays, repeated-call pairs, library comparators, controls, and uncertainty summaries. Four dataset/model conditions test one shared fixed-game thesis, with forest algebra and logistic integration as condition-specific computations. The final evaluation is independently completed and qualified; this is a documented evaluation outcome, not scientific proof of general reliability. A certificate-centered paper is weaker because certificate decisions and acceptance coverage are not recorded. A general high-risk deployment paper exceeds the fixed-background, scalar-encoded, small-instance evidence. A logistic-only paper discards the independently useful forest conditions. A search-success narrative confuses development evidence with the final evaluation. The chosen story retains direct comparisons and limitations without requiring new experiments.
edit_framing_decision: No edit-mode files, previous_paper directory, or prior manuscript were supplied. Recentered refers to narrowing the broad source-task motivation to the evaluated fixed-game computational question, not to revising an unseen manuscript. Preserving the broad deployment story was rejected; a shared cross-model computation story was selected over a logistic-only recentering.
staged_input_impact: There are no staged prior/new manuscript pairs or extra_tasks/aggregated directories; no inherited title, thesis, or figure plan is assumed.

paper_data.json.final_evaluation supplies three final episodes and four public-data/model conditions with one-shot library and split-budget two-start comparators; these observations, not qualitative memory, determine the central results.

paper_data.json.downstream_study and study.* grounding sources are absent. Do not invent a frozen-study selection contract, search-score differences, attempt counts, or an original-incumbent comparison from memory.

Recoverable source under results/ideas/03_probability_scale_logistic_shap_by_bounded_fourier_quadrature/program_1/src implements both forest and logistic computations. Earlier reliability.py files differ by the corresponding imports/dispatches, supporting bounded development-set component comparisons rather than a chronology.

The best-program manifest links the recoverable implementation to the final-tested configuration at path/selection level. The final manifest records a program-tree digest, but this strategy does not independently establish a byte-for-byte final snapshot match; algorithm descriptions are source-grounded and measured behavior is final-evidence-grounded.
VENUE.md and the actual ICLR style require a single-column, anonymized, 8–9 body-page paper; the plan uses readable full-text-width figures rather than assuming a two-column format.

method_groups.name: One-shot library Kernel SHAP
method_groups.include_reason: The evaluator records identity-link shap.KernelExplainer outputs, l1_reg=0.0, for the same frozen model, queries, empirical background, and nominal coalition caps. This is a measured comparator, not a literature-only baseline.

method_groups.name: Two-start Kernel SHAP with split coalition caps
method_groups.include_reason: Two independent library estimates each receive half the nominal cap and are averaged. This tests a practical repeat-and-average alternative without silently doubling its coalition allocation; actual row counts and endpoint overhead need not match the one-shot method.

method_groups.name: Structure-aware fixed-game computation
method_groups.include_reason: One shared estimator family preserves the finite empirical interventional probability game: exact leaf-literal algebra for forests, bounded Fourier/Owen integration for nonexhaustive logistic requests, exhaustive nonforest computation when the cap covers all subsets, and the existing sampled fallback on numerical rejection. Do not claim observed branch frequencies from unrecorded internal diagnostics.

method_groups.name: Sampled path/regression configuration
method_groups.include_reason: The configuration without either structure-aware component has measured development-set outputs. Compare it directly with the forest-enabled configuration on forest conditions; it is not the untouched original incumbent and is not a separately final-evaluated method. Its internal confidence-bound code does not supply measured certificate coverage.

method_groups.name: Forest-enabled, sampled-logistic configuration
method_groups.include_reason: Its source retains the exact forest branch but lacks logistic quadrature. Matched development episodes isolate the logistic dispatch addition; unchanged forest outputs act as a component-locality check. These comparisons are descriptive selected-development evidence, not independent confirmation.

method_groups.name: Same-game references and analytic controls
method_groups.include_reason: ACS has exhaustive 10-feature references; German has the mean of two 4096-coalition library estimates and recorded half-differences, not exact ground truth. Zero, affine, feature-permutation, and reset/replay observations check specific properties but do not validate all nonlinear numerical paths.

results_focus: Primary final comparison: normalized L1 reference agreement for the three measured methods at caps 64, 256, and 1024, separately for German/logistic, German/forest, ACS/logistic, and ACS/forest. Preserve episode-level variation and the difference between exhaustive and approximate references.

Final reliability decomposition: reference top-three overlap, all-coordinate sign agreement with the evaluator's 1e-8 zero tolerance, and within-instance repeated-call top-three/sign consistency are different quantities. The final aggregate reports reference agreement 0.9975639445869278, top-three overlap 1.0, and sign agreement 0.9997395833333332; no generic reliable/not-reliable label is justified by these alone.

Observed candidate repeat-pair top-three and sign agreement is 1.0 in every final empirical condition. Do not infer baseline within-model repeatability: the stored library comparators have one estimate per cap per episode, not six repeated estimates on each frozen model.

Reference limitation: near-numerical-precision agreement on exhaustive ACS games contrasts with residual differences against approximate German references. Do not attribute all German residuals to the candidate or all to reference noise. Report the stored reference half-differences separately from confidence intervals.

Development-only component comparisons: forest-enabled versus sampled-only on forest conditions, and full structure-aware versus forest-enabled on logistic conditions, at matched caps 64/256 and seeds 1729/2718. Keep these in a clearly labeled development-data results block; never connect configurations as a search trajectory.

Negative evidence: splitting cap 64 between two starts has especially low German reference agreement, while high-cap ACS one-shot estimates reach exhaustive computation and close the gap. Show these measured limitations without diagnosing rank deficiency or another cause that the evidence does not identify.

Integrity and costs: final.qualification.status=completed, final.qualification.outcome=qualified, final.qualification.correct=true; no failed qualification is reported in this run. Controls, failed-call fraction, efficiency residual, and reset/replay are narrow checks, not an accuracy or validity guarantee. The 700.3707705293782-second final wall total includes multiple methods and reference work and is not candidate latency.
figure_plan: Figure 1, early overview: a fixed empirical game feeds sampled and structure-aware computations; audit repeated-call consistency and same-game reference agreement separately, ending at an explicit deployment-scope boundary.

Figure 2, main comparison: a four-panel categorical comparison of final reference agreement by coalition cap and method, with individual episode markers and exact/approximate reference labels; no trajectory lines or search indices.

Figure 3, component comparison: two panels of matched development-set comparisons for forest algebra and logistic integration, with datasets and caps as categorical conditions and two compared configurations per panel.

figure_specs.purpose: Make the fixed-game object, two computational approaches, two distinct reliability assessments, and the limit on deployment interpretation immediately legible.
figure_specs.metric: none; conceptual evidence map with no invented quantitative content
figure_specs.split_by: fixed game, sampled computation, structure-aware computation, repeat consistency, reference agreement, scope boundary
figure_specs.layout_rationale: The actual ICLR article style sets textwidth=5.5in and textheight=9in and uses one column. Use the full 5.5in text width, approximately 1.6–1.8in high plus a short caption, on page 1 or 2 (about 0.23 body page). Six concise labeled blocks and at least 9pt final-size text remain legible without a miniature algorithm flowchart.

figure_specs.purpose: Compare measured one-shot library, split-cap averaging, and structure-aware outputs within each final dataset/model condition without pooling away reference-quality differences.
figure_specs.split_by: dataset x classifier, with exhaustive versus approximate reference stated in each panel
figure_specs.layout_rationale: At 5.5in full text width, a 2x2 grid gives approximately 2.6in per panel; three short cap labels and three method series fit with 9pt labels and one shared legend. Target approximately 3.5–4in height plus caption (about 0.48 page). A hypothetical half-width placement would make four panels unreadable. Use a common 0–1 agreement axis and explicit numeric annotations or the companion table for ceiling-level differences, not a concealed truncated scale.

figure_specs.purpose: Test whether the observed development-data differences localize to the forest and logistic components rather than presenting configuration order as evidence.
figure_specs.metric: normalized L1 reference agreement, using the same definition as the final comparison
figure_specs.split_by: forest component and logistic component, explicitly development data
figure_specs.layout_rationale: Two side-by-side panels at 5.5in full text width, approximately 2.2–2.5in high plus caption (about 0.32 page). Each has four abbreviated dataset/cap categories and two configuration series, with the two episode points shown rather than invented standard errors. Keep 9pt labels and explanatory full labels in the caption; simplify rather than shrink. Do not add an ordering axis or arrows between configurations.

supplementary_plan.purpose: Provide substantive implementation, uncertainty, and reproducibility depth after the references while retaining the central final comparisons, component evidence, and decisive scope limitations in the main body; no new experiments or invented posthoc rankings are required.

planned_subsections.heading: Fixed-Game Definition and Preprocessing
planned_subsections.grounded_content: Expand the empirical interventional game and probability output scale; document original scalar feature groups, training-only ordinal vocabulary, median imputation and scaling, fixed 16-row background, and fixed query selection using task/evaluate_final.py and task/resources/final/*. Document that this is neither conditional attribution nor raw-preprocessing resampling. Include the actual German and ACS split/provenance records and ACSIncome-2024-RELSHIPP adapter.

planned_subsections.heading: Structure-Aware Computation and Numerical Safeguards
planned_subsections.grounded_content: Expand forest leaf inclusion/exclusion coefficients, repeated-split intersection, averaging over every background row/tree, and float32 traversal semantics from forest.py. Expand the logistic Fourier/Owen identity, exact inclusion-polynomial quadrature, frequency truncation, refinement checks, work caps, exhaustive dispatch, and sampled fallback from logistic_fourier.py and reliability.py. Explicitly distinguish an analytic frequency-tail bound from an unproved total discretization-error guarantee; validation scripts are available source, not evidence that they were run.

planned_subsections.heading: Episode-Level Reliability and Reference Uncertainty
planned_subsections.grounded_content: Tabulate every stored final case/cap/episode summary, existing case-level instance-bootstrap intervals, analytic-control observations, reset/replay result, reference half-differences, and model fit diagnostics. Explain each interval's conditional scope and keep repetitions, instance pairs, and overlapping episodes from being counted as independent samples. Any extra quantitative panels must be reproducible descriptive views of these arrays, not fabricated confidence bands.

planned_subsections.heading: Component Comparison Details
planned_subsections.grounded_content: Supply complete per-condition development comparison tables and the inspected reliability.py dispatch differences. Include unchanged-family checks and any regressions or nonmonotone budget behavior already recorded. Make the development/final separation explicit and do not describe search ranking as an independent replication or report unscored alternatives as measured losses.

planned_subsections.heading: Reproducibility and Compute Accounting
planned_subsections.grounded_content: Document task/requirements.txt, each retained program_spec.toml, evaluator and dataset provenance files, resource hashes, training and explanation seeds, and offline acquisition/reproduction paths. Distinguish measured total wall time and baseline productive_seconds/prediction_rows from unrecorded candidate per-call latency. List the exact final plot/table scripts once implemented, with source pointers into paper_data.json; do not claim those future scripts already exist. Keep internal machine paths out of the anonymous manuscript.

notes_for_writer: Main-body architecture and footprint, inclusive of figures/tables: introduction and early overview 1.25 pages; related work 0.65; fixed-game estimand and metrics 1.0; model-specific computation 1.4; experimental and statistical protocol 1.05; results and component comparison 2.0; limitations and interpretation 0.9; conclusion 0.25. Total target 8.5 pages under the supplied 8–9-page venue rule. An 8-page body must fill at least 75% of its final page. Use remaining space for equations, reference limitations and fair comparison, not more search history or oversized figures.

Two compact main tables complement the figures: an experimental-design table with dataset version, split, feature count, background, model, reference type and cap; and a final-reliability table with condition-specific reference agreement, stored conditional intervals at their actual scope, top-three/sign agreement and repeat consistency. Keep global integrity checks in a short adjacent paragraph rather than relabeling them as predictive accuracy.

Template inspection: .codex/skills/write-paper-standalone/templates/iclr/paper.tex uses article plus paper,times; paper.sty specifies 5.5in text width and 9in text height, with no two-column layout. Full_width means one full text column, not a two-column float. Do not use the template's sample title or author block; omit identifying material and final-copy author mode for the double-blind paper while preserving required template infrastructure.

Final qualification must remain auditable through final.qualification.status, final.qualification.outcome, and final.qualification.correct. In this run they report completed, qualified, and true. Reader-facing disclosure should say the evaluation met its documented completeness and analytic-control requirements, not that scientific reliability was certified. Review/audit/revision must preserve this scope; if later authoritative evidence reports failed qualification, disclose it explicitly and do not diagnose performance, validity or adaptivity causes without criterion evidence.

The final tested method is primary. Private-only source bridge: best_program_manifest.json names the recoverable third configuration; final_evaluation independently records final outcomes. No downstream_study or study.* records exist, so do not publish search selection scores, score differences, attempt totals or an alleged original baseline win. The memory-only incumbent score is not a comparator.

Use final.evidence.episodes for the main per-condition results and final.metric.* for aggregate checks. Private-only: result.top_program_01/02/03 identify the full, forest-enabled, and sampled configurations; follow each all_programs evaluation_evidence.episodes array for development comparisons. Those source IDs' scalar values alone do not establish an ablation. Trace the array path and inspected source change in downstream claim mappings; do not invent missing grounding IDs.

Data regime: German has 20 supplied scalar feature groups and final retained splits 300 train/100 validation/100 explanation; ACS has 10 groups and 20000/6667/6667. Only the first 16 explanation instances and first 16 training-background rows are used in the final study. These split counts are from the inspected resource records, not measurements of generalization. Name ACSIncome-2024-RELSHIPP explicitly, retain the provenance adapter and the search/final content-disjointness construction, and do not call it bit-identical historical ACSIncome.

Frozen model conditions are logistic regression (lbfgs, max_iter=500, tol=1e-7) and forests (64 trees, max_depth=6, n_jobs=1). Final episode seeds are 104729, 130363 and 155921; each has caps 64/256/1024 and six candidate calls per cap. Fixed instances recur across episodes; model randomness can differ for forests, while logistic fitting may be deterministic. Do not count these as 48 independent queried people or treat six deterministic repeats as six independent fidelity observations.

Use the exact evaluator definitions: reference agreement is reciprocal normalized L1 error with a 0.001 denominator floor; top-three compares absolute attribution sets with original-column tie breaking; sign agreement covers all coordinates with an absolute 1e-8 zero threshold; normalized efficiency residual is capped at one with a 0.001 denominator floor. These are not user-validated reliability thresholds, calibration scores, causal correctness, or fairness assessments.

Existing 95% bootstrap intervals resample 16 instance-level agreement summaries after averaging candidate repeats and caps, conditional on one model/reference, with 1000 resamples and seed 84017. They are not per-cap intervals, do not incorporate approximate-reference error, and cannot be averaged into a new interval. Show per-episode points for budget-specific comparisons and label any descriptive range as a range, not a confidence interval. Do not manufacture significance claims.

German references average two 4096-coalition library estimates; abs(first-second)/2 is a disagreement proxy, not a confidence bound. ACS references enumerate all 2^10 coalitions. The candidate's nonforest exhaustive dispatch activates when cap >= 2^d-2, so ACS logistic cap 1024 does not demonstrate the quadrature branch. Forest dispatch precedes that check. Branch acceptance/rejection counts, certificate coverage, and total quadrature error certificates are not recorded; deterministic output does not recover those missing facts.

Model-agnostic library comparators use prediction queries; the proposed computation receives model parameters. A nominal sampled-coalition cap is not a matched arithmetic, wall-clock or information-access budget. Actual baseline prediction rows are recorded; candidate per-call timing and comparable prediction-cost diagnostics are not. Report measured total time only in its correct all-work scope; do not substitute the source task's estimated CPU-hour budget for observed usage.

Current sources support a bounded engineering/methodology contribution, not first-ever exact tree attribution or first-ever SHAP stability analysis. The bibliography is a noisy retrieved candidate pool with metadata-level provenance, not proof every source has been read. Use only relevant permitted primary works actually consulted and keys present in references.bib, starting from Lundberg2017AUA, Musco2024ProvablyAS, and appropriate tree-attribution records after verification. Missing Owen/empirical-Bernstein/semantics sources cannot be replaced with invented citations or unsupported novelty claims; keep nonessential certificate theory out of the central contribution.

No external paper pages were accessed during this strategy stage, and no prohibited encounter was identified here. Do not infer that prior retrieval was fully reviewed or contamination-free merely from its presence. Any actual prohibited encounter must be stopped and recorded with URL and extent of reading.

All main quantitative views are descriptive transformations of retained measured arrays, with scripts and source pointers preserved. Do not invent runs, confidence bands, missing measurements, calibration, background-size sensitivity, latency distributions, acceptance coverage, alternative datasets or tested external TreeSHAP/leverage-score baselines. Unscored or unrun alternatives remain missing evidence, never measured losses. Standalone forest/logistic validation scripts being present does not establish their execution.

Use vector-first matplotlib outputs: preserve plotting source/data and export both PDF and PNG, PNG at 300 DPI; LaTeX must prefer PDF whenever it exists. A raster-only full-width figure must be regenerated from source at >=2400px wide, and any column/partial-width raster at >=1200px; never upscale. Prefer a PDF exported from its vector source when available; otherwise require the full-width raster minimum and a recorded prompt/source manifest. Do not invoke image generation during strategy planning.

Use consistent method colors: gray for one-shot library, orange for split-cap averaging, blue for structure-aware computation. Use gray for the disabled component and blue for the enabled component in development comparisons, explicitly label that local contrast, and preserve meanings in legends. Distinguish reference quality with text rather than reassigning method colors. Avoid decorative failure/success icons that imply unmeasured thresholds.

Keep the main conclusion conditional: one call is adequate for the observed same-game top-three/sign/reference-agreement criteria in these evaluated conditions, not universally adequate as a reason for a prediction. No task-specific acceptable-error threshold or human decision study was prespecified. Small fixed query sets, fixed nonrepresentative background choice, scalar categorical encoding, approximate German references, unrecorded branch diagnostics, and no human/causal/background-shift validation must appear in the main limitations, not only the supplement.

After the main body, flush floats, place references, then clear the page and use appendix plus a Supplementary Information section with substantive subsections. Add a separate LLM Usage section, preferably there, disclosing the documented roles in ideation, code preparation and paper planning/writing without inventing model identifiers or human review. Follow any supplied authoritative appendix rankings later without retroactively changing this strategy or hiding central evidence.
